messages.content: Show a sample service health overview.

root = SagaPage([Text({"text": "Service health overview · handcrafted offline example"}), Alert({"title": "Sample data", "text": "This example is authored locally. No live monitoring or model call was used.", "severity": "info"}), BigValue({"value": {"numeric": 99.98, "text": "99.98", "suffix": "% uptime", "color": "green"}, "width": 360, "height": 150, "colorMode": "value", "graphMode": "none"}), Table({"columns": ["Service", "Status", "Latency"], "rows": [["API gateway", "Healthy", "42 ms"], ["Checkout", "Healthy", "78 ms"], ["Worker", "Degraded", "240 ms"]], "width": 650, "height": 220})])
